title: Commission must enforce order
description: Enforce order in the same manner as a Court decree

content.who: District Commission, State Commission or the National Commission
conditions: Every order made by a District Commission, State Commission or the National Commission
limitations: as far as may be applicable
subject to the modification that every reference therein to the decree shall be construed as reference to the order made under this Act
